title: First Steps: Polynomial Generator
description: Runnable Section 9.9 polynomial generator walkthrough for X/Y display.

walkthrough.title: Generate the x ramp
walkthrough.text: P1 scales -1 into the first inverting integrator. With IC driven by +1, I1.out starts at x=-1 and ramps to +1 across the default 2 s REPF run.

walkthrough.title: Generate powers of x
walkthrough.text: I2 starts at -1 and receives two x contributions, one directly and one through XIR1, so it follows -x^2. I3 starts at -1 and receives three -x^2 contributions, one direct and two through XIR2, so it follows x^3.

walkthrough.title: Scale polynomial terms
walkthrough.text: P2 produces d, P3 produces c*x, P4 receives x^2 and produces b*x^2, and P5 receives -x^3 to implement the default negative cubic term a*x^3.

walkthrough.title: Display p(x)
walkthrough.text: SUM1 combines the four terms as a negating summer and INV3 recovers p(x). OUT X carries x and OUT Y carries p(x), making the preset ready for X/Y display.
